summary: The tracked conversion rate went from 3.98% to 2.58% (−35.2%) between 2026-09-19…2026-10-02 vs 2026-10-03…2026-10-16. One source explains most of it: native_network_a grew from 20.2% to 47.3% of sessions while its conversion rate fell from 2.98% to 0.70%, starting with the traffic change recorded at 2026-10-05 08:00 UTC (change #2). Lower-quality traffic from native_network_a is the likely cause.

observations.statement: Between 2026-09-19…2026-10-02 vs 2026-10-03…2026-10-16 the tracked conversion rate went from 3.98% to 2.58% (−35.2%); the change is statistically significant (p < 0.001).
Daily conversion rate averaged 4.00% before 2026-10-05 and 2.42% from 2026-10-05 on (change point; 16 vs 12 days, −39.4%).
native_network_a explains 96% of the tracked CR change (−1.35 pp of −1.40 pp): share of sessions 20.2% → 47.3%, CR 2.98% → 0.70%, clicks→sessions 0.919 → 0.559.
CR changes differ across source segments (−76.5% to +1.0%); mix effect −0.34 pp, rate effect −1.06 pp.
Change #2 at 2026-10-05 08:00 UTC, category traffic, by media-buyer (text in untrusted content).

evidenceIndex.E1: Baseline 2026-09-19…2026-10-02: 16,773 sessions, 668 tracked conversions, CR 3.98%, spend $12,081.49; current 2026-10-03…2026-10-16: 25,429 sessions, 656 tracked conversions, CR 2.58%, spend $18,373.1.
evidenceIndex.E2: Tracked CR changed from 3.98% (668 / 16,773 sessions, 2026-09-19…2026-10-02) to 2.58% (656 / 25,429 sessions, 2026-10-03…2026-10-16): −1.40 pp (−35.2%); two-proportion z-test p < 0.001, 95% CI of the difference [−1.76 pp, −1.05 pp] — significant; −0.9 tracked conversions/day.
evidenceIndex.E3: Daily conversion rate averaged 4.00% before 2026-10-05 and 2.42% from 2026-10-05 on (change point; 16 vs 12 days, −39.4%).
evidenceIndex.E4: native_network_a explains 96% of the tracked CR change (−1.35 pp of −1.40 pp): share of sessions 20.2% → 47.3%, CR 2.98% → 0.70%, clicks→sessions 0.919 → 0.559.
evidenceIndex.E5: CR changes differ across source segments (−76.5% to +1.0%); mix effect −0.34 pp, rate effect −1.06 pp.
evidenceIndex.E6: Change #1 at 2026-09-25 13:00 UTC, category other, by social-team (text in untrusted content).
evidenceIndex.E7: Change #2 at 2026-10-05 08:00 UTC, category traffic, by media-buyer (text in untrusted content).
